claim: Will METR publish independent safety evaluations after gaining access to Anthropic?
sourceFinding: Anthropic said six METR employees received employee-like access to selected internal resources and that METR may publish analyses, subject to predefined redactions.
evidenceLimits: An access agreement is not a completed independent safety audit. Anthropic's disclosure describes limits on privileged information and publication redactions.
nextEvidenceTrigger: Public METR analysis with disclosed test scope, evidence, access limits and independent conclusions.
sourceTimeline: 2026-10-15: evaluator arrangement announced; 2026-10-16: terms clarification noted
trackedPromise: METR will publish independent risk-assessment findings; no fixed publication date
